services.name: Family Fright Night
services.desc: The Naranjo Museum of Natural History in Lufkin hosts an annual Family Fright Night in October, featuring, games, crafts, face painting, and extensive trick-or-treating within the museum. The 2026 event will be held on October 23rd from 6-9 p.m.. It is designed as a family-friendly Halloween event. Get ready for a spook-tacular evening of fun at the Naranjo Museum of Natural History’s Family Fright Night Halloween Party! Bring the whole family for a night packed with treats, activities, and festive fun-perfect for all ages! Costumes encouraged - show off your spooky style! services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Naranjo Museum Summer Camps take place in the summer starting June 1, 2026 and are both half day and full day camps for children who enjoy learning about natural history and science. There are different themes for camps and children learn through crafts, experiments and other hands-on activities. Week 2: June 8-12th When Worlds Changed: Extinction & Survival! for students age 9-13 ½ Day options are 8am-12pm or 1pm-5pm and cost: VIP $70, Member: $80, Non Member $90. Full Day: 8am-5pm with a lunch from 12pm-1pm and cost: VIP $140, Member $160, Non Member
